microbenchmarks.scope: Matched construction-only test owners on a shared host, after this follow-up compilers and macro benchmarks; Linux is an ARM64 VM with two CPUs and 1 GiB. Not device-cache eviction. Allocation counters are not RSS.

wire_migration: Frozen baselines use their original value_search_execution/profile.value_search spelling through an explicit benchmark-only adapter. Current functional tests require execution.value_verification/profile.value_verification and reject removed request aliases. Upgrade/rollback tests use each preserved binary’s own protocol.
limits: Reader calibration bound assumes stable caps and completed calls; refusals/truncations do not train untested arms. Writes invalidate whole-generation source proofs; per-segment cross-write certificates remain future work. Direct retained count borrows eliminate result-bitmap allocation, not complete request work.
